name: Morrígan
abilities: Lugh: Sídhe Court Covenant Sundering Trial
Divine Ascension — Tír na nÓg Moon-Sovereign Form
passives: Geas Bloom: Lugh gains Geas when breaker play marks armor, guard, or ritual structure for staged rupture on sídhe-root crossing. At 3 stacks, the next Technique or Reaction adds a geas sovereignty rider; at 5 stacks, the Signature upgrades once and then empties the meter. Momentum feeds the setup, Divinity empowers the finisher, and Earth myth remains only the echo of Avalora.
lore: Morrígan, Battle-Crow Fate Queen, is now canonized as one of the four playable deities of Tuatha. The deity is the source-realm divinity behind the mythology rather than a generic champion: war fate goddess, battle-crow prophecy, sovereignty terror and doom rupture. All prior faction, realm, civilization, campaign, and Lore Codex canon remains intact; only the playable roster scale and divine identity layer changed.
personality: A playable mythology deity whose behavior expresses war fate goddess, battle-crow prophecy, sovereignty terror and doom rupture; confident, sovereign, readable in combat, loyal to the unchanged Tuatha canon.
visualDescription: Morrígan manifests as war fate goddess, battle-crow prophecy, sovereignty terror and doom rupture from Tuatha: striking dangerous feminine face, pale sharp cheekbones, black eyes, predatory lips, prophecy stare; tall fierce feminine warrior-seer physique, narrow waist, strong hips, long limbs, commanding predatory posture; signature silhouette: crow wing mantle, horned battle crown, long spear, feathered shadow outline. Weapon: black spear of fate and crow-feather sickle dagger. Maintain the approved Mythos Gates premium stylized tactical RPG aesthetic.
developmentStatus: Combat kit, source-culture weapons, gear, abilities, leveling hooks, and balance pass complete; artwork pending.

abilityDetails.name: Lugh — Silver-Lughch Cut Rend
abilityDetails.effect: Deal Tuatha source-culture damage at range 2; generate Momentum and a small Geas Memory gain when used from silver-root fae ground or against the marked target. The hit reads visually as silver branches, living oak armor, thorn mantles, standing stones, battle-crow omens, cauldron glow, moonlit green-gold, geas scars.
abilityDetails.scaling: 100% attack; +15% when the target is vulnerable or standing in faction-favored terrain
abilityDetails.counterplay: Break line of sight, deny favored terrain, bait the mark, or force the Deity into low-value targets.

abilityDetails.name: Geas Thorn Technique — Rupture
abilityDetails.effect: Spend Momentum to breaks guard, exposes vulnerability, and punishes armor or shield reliance. Builds Geas Memory only when the Avatar uses silver-root fae ground intelligently; never a generic buff button.
abilityDetails.scaling: 70% attack plus role utility scaling from energy and mastery tier
abilityDetails.counterplay: Interrupt before resolution, spread enemy ranks, deny the setup terrain, or bait the cooldown.

abilityDetails.name: Lugh: Sídhe Court Covenant Sundering Trial
abilityDetails.effect: Spend stored Geas Memory to impose a two-round rule from Avalora: breaks guard, exposes vulnerability, and punishes armor or shield reliance. Enemies receive a readable counter-window before the strongest effect lands.
abilityDetails.scaling: 140% attack where damage applies; utility duration +1 at mastery tier 4
abilityDetails.counterplay: Move out of the rule zone, drain Momentum/Divinity, stagger the Deity, or exploit the exposed recovery turn.

abilityDetails.name: Divine Ascension — Tír na nÓg Moon-Sovereign Form
abilityDetails.effect: Enter Ascendant stance for 2 rounds: amplify Geas Memory, transform nearby terrain into silver-root fae ground, empower one Signature, and reveal the Realm as the original source behind human myth. Ends with a one-round recovery risk.
abilityDetails.scaling: Does not stack with external ultimate buffs
abilityDetails.counterplay: Survive the window, disengage from transformed terrain, deny objectives during recovery, or force defensive reaction spending.

equipmentDetails.name: Lugh Sunderer Lugh Silver-Spear Thornblade
equipmentDetails.effect: +3 attack. Basic attacks gain +4 Momentum once per round when they express source-culture canon through silver-root fae ground. Visual: silver branches, living oak armor, thorn mantles, standing stones, battle-crow omens, cauldron glow, moonlit green-gold, geas scars.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: No extra action loops; empowered basics are once per round.

equipmentDetails.name: Lugh Moon-Oak Sídhe Mantle
equipmentDetails.effect: Improves survivability and makes the Deity read as Avalora source-culture gear, not costume armor. Reduces first terrain/hazard punishment each encounter if the Avatar followed the faction mechanic.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: Mitigation cannot stack past role caps; does not erase telegraphed boss danger.

equipmentDetails.name: Lugh Dagda Cauldron Memory Core
equipmentDetails.effect: Stores Geas Memory and unlocks a mastery branch for Sídhe Mound Slip, Fae Glamour Reversal, and Collect the Geas Debt. Rewards correct terrain and reaction play rather than passive stat gain.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: Resource refund has a per-round cap and cannot chain Ascension windows.

leveling.powerFormula: hp + attack*6 + range*5 + energy*7 + speed*6 + armor*2 + resistance*2 + critChance

balanceNotes.intendedDifficulty: Tuned for harder solo encounters: every deity can win alone, but mistakes against counters starve Momentum/Divinity.
balanceNotes.primaryRole: break armor, shields, and boss windows
balanceNotes.uniqueMechanic: Lugh's Geas Bloom: a solo mechanic where Geas grows through sídhe-root crossing, reaction-window mastery, and breaker decisions that mark armor, guard, or ritual structure for staged rupture. Payoff: turn correct sequencing into burst windows against bosses and shields. Counterplay: mistimed burst leaves the Deity exposed during recovery; enemies can also drain Momentum/Divinity before the upgraded Signature resolves.
balanceNotes.counterplayRule: mistimed burst leaves the Deity exposed during recovery
